name: BTC Miners Position Index
description: Miner Outflow / 1-Year Avg Miner Outflow. Normalized ratio showing if miners are dumping more or less than usual. >2.0 = Panic selling. <0.5 = Holding/Accumulating.
trading_signal: >2.0 → Miner dump risk (Bearish, veto longs). <0.5 → Miner confidence (Bullish confirmation).
